title: should dismiss the open Help dropdown and open the Data flyout when hovering the Data tile
verifies: hovering the Data group tile dispatches a synthetic Escape that closes the open Help dropdown while the Data flyout opens

title: should open the Data flyout without a stray Escape when no dropdown is open
verifies: with no dropdown open the flyout still opens and no dropdown is accidentally opened/left behind

title: should open the Data flyout and navigate when clicking the Data tile
verifies: clicking the Data tile opens the flyout immediately (no hover debounce) and navigates to /streams

title: should dismiss the open Profile dropdown when hovering the Data tile
verifies: the dismiss is not Help-specific; the Profile dropdown is closed by the same synthetic Escape
